skill.displayName: Today in History - 历史上的今天

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: todayhistory
Version: 1.0.3

The skill is a legitimate implementation for querying historical events via the JisuAPI service. The Python script (todayhistory.py) correctly uses environment variables for API keys and performs standard HTTP GET requests to the official endpoint (api.jisuapi.com) without any signs of data exfiltration, command injection, or malicious instructions in the documentation (SKILL.md).

llm.summary: The skill does what it says: it calls JisuAPI's 'today in history' endpoint and only requires a JISU_API_KEY and Python; nothing requested is disproportionate to its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the behavior. The only required credential is JISU_API_KEY and the script calls api.jisuapi.com — these are appropriate and expected for a 'today in history' integration.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs exporting JISU_API_KEY and running the included script with a JSON month/day body. It does not ask the agent to read unrelated files, other env vars, or exfiltrate arbitrary data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only), which minimizes risk. One mismatch: the Python script imports the 'requests' library but the skill does not declare how to install Python packages. This may cause runtime errors or require the host to preinstall requests.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only JISU_API_KEY is required (declared as primary). No other secrets, unrelated credentials, or system config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent or elevated privileges, nor does it modify other skills or system configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and limited: it will make HTTPS requests to api.jisuapi.com using the JISU_API_KEY you provide. Before installing, ensure you trust JisuAPI and are comfortable sharing that API key with the skill. Also confirm your Python environment has the 'requests' package (pip install requests) because the skill's files import it but the skill provides no install step. Check API key quotas/permissions and consider using a key with limited scope or an account you control. If you want stricter assurance, review the included todayhistory.py (it is short and readable) and verify it only sends month/day and the appkey to the documented endpoint.
